CustomField.description: Label for the button that opens the form when referenceFormDisplayType__c is modal (#391). When blank the runtime falls back to a default derived from the override type: Start New Form for startnewform, View Form for vieweditsubmission. Ignored in inline mode and when referenceFieldOverrideType__c is standard or component.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Label shown on the button that opens the form in a modal. Leave blank to use a default that matches the override type, such as Start New Form or View Form. Has no effect when the display type is Inline.
CustomField.label: referenceFormButtonLabel
